200ft....the washers move to the center of the string.

300ft.....more noise and that string is about an inch lower.

Emergency surface has been ordered and that means you do all ahead flank (fast as the boat can go, and evacuation of all water from the ballast tanks.

I swear that for a moment you feel weightless as the boat comes out of the water. It took just a moment to get to the top of the water.
